no-restricted-globals.name: parseFloat
no-restricted-globals.message: Money crosses the wire as a decimal string and stays one. parseFloat makes it an IEEE 754 double, which cannot represent most decimal fractions and drops the trailing zeros that are the pennies — silently. Use src/money/amount.ts. If this value genuinely is not money, disable this line with a comment saying what it is.

no-restricted-globals.name: parseInt
no-restricted-globals.message: See parseFloat. If this value genuinely is not money, disable this line with a comment saying what it is.

no-restricted-globals.name: Number
no-restricted-globals.message: Restricting the Number global also covers Number(x), Number.parseFloat and Number.parseInt — the routes by which an amount becomes a double. Use src/money/amount.ts for money. If this value genuinely is not money, disable this line with a comment saying what it is.
